# Smith 0.2

> Native Elixir CAD: immutable recipes, geometry measurements, structured inspection, assemblies, dimensioned drawings, and verified printable exports.

Use the installed package version. Models work in .exs scripts and Livebook.
Inspection JSON supports agents without vision; PNG observations require no
browser or GPU. Check report.status, not just the outer {:ok, report} tuple.

## Start here

- [CAD concepts](https://hexdocs.pm/smith/cad-basics.md): terminology, coordinate conventions, and tolerances.
- [Livebook catalog](https://hexdocs.pm/smith/livebook.md): lessons ordered by topic and complexity.
- [Agent modeling guide](https://hexdocs.pm/smith/agent-modeling.md): workflow, tool selection, and limits.
- [Inspection and validation](https://hexdocs.pm/smith/inspection.md): runnable reporting and measurement examples.
- [Full API index](https://hexdocs.pm/smith/llms.txt): ExDoc-generated Markdown documentation.
- [Smith CAD skill](skills/smith-cad/SKILL.md): optional instructions for skill-aware coding harnesses.

## APIs

- [Smith](https://hexdocs.pm/smith/Smith.md): modeling recipes and snapshot reuse.
- [Inspection](https://hexdocs.pm/smith/Smith.Inspection.md): named sources, checks, topology pages, and artifacts.
- [Measurements](https://hexdocs.pm/smith/Smith.Measure.md): geometry-derived values and anchors.
- [Headless rendering](https://hexdocs.pm/smith/Smith.Render.md): standard PNG views and colored stages.
- [Drawings](https://hexdocs.pm/smith/Smith.Drawing.md): orthographic SVG/DXF and measured SVG annotations.
- [OCEx](https://hexdocs.pm/ocex/llms.txt): native geometry contracts and installation.
